---
title: "Presidential Approval Ratings"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

# Clean percentage strings and order presidents by average rating
approval_data <- read_csv("data/presidential_approval.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    Avg = parse_number(Avg),
    President = fct_reorder(President, Avg),
    Party = if_else(Party == "D", "Democrat", "Republican")
  )

# Simple horizontal bar chart of average approval ratings
ggplot(approval_data, aes(x = Avg, y = President, fill = Party)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Avg, "%")), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Democrat" = "#2E74C0", "Republican" = "#CB454A")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 75, by = 5),
    labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 76),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average U.S. Presidential Approval Rating",
    subtitle = "Dashed line indicates 50% approval mark",
    x = "Average Approval Rating",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Party",
    caption = "Source: Dave Manuel (Gallup data)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```
